rows.label: Helios Blueprint
rows.note: cheapest sentinel blueprint in the dojo

conditions: Cephalon Simaris does not sell this. He sells Detect Vulnerability, the Helios precept mod, for 75,000 standing

rows.label: Helios
rows.alt: or 75 p built from the Market

conditions: Two companion slots go at claim time, one for Helios and one for the bundled Deconstructor. A single free slot is not enough
A Forma you build costs 35,000 credits, 1 Morphics, 1 Neural Sensors, 1 Neurodes, 1 Orokin Cell and 23h, so budget it before starting
bonuses: Ships with the Deconstructor, a sentinel weapon usable only by Helios and Helios Prime
75 p for a built Helios skips the entire chain and is cheaper than rushing any part of it

disclosures.title: Helios Prime is a different item
disclosures.body: Helios Prime is relic-farmed. Building Helios does not progress it.
